# Title Opinion: NW/4 of Section 22, Block C-9, Larkspur Rail Survey, Mesquite Flats County, TX

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
- Mineral title to the subject tract is 87.5% reconciled; the remaining 12.5% is subject to 2 material defects.
- **D1:** 1/8 mineral interest passes through the unprobated Estate of Wendell Ashby; heirship not of record.
- **D2:** 1974 deed to Harlan Pettibone grants 1/4 but its habendum recites 5/16 (possible 1/16 overgrant).
- **D3:** 1981 oil and gas lease to Dunmore Exploration has no recorded release.
- **D4:** Tobin Creek Royalty NPRI of 1/32 is floating vs. fixed (ambiguous "1/32 of royalty" language).
